mdRecord.dcterms:title: Simpkins-Phillips-Turpin & Quesenberry Cemetery, Indian Valley
mdRecord.dcterms:description:
Located on an open hilltop above 2463 Macks Mountain Rd NW. Access is thru a gate beside the cemetery signage via easement that runs just outside the boundary fence with 2463 Macks Mountain Rd NW. the terrain is very steep approaching the cemetery. The cemetery is fenced and very well maintained. Cemetery is visible using Google Earth. N 36 55.991' W 80 36.609'
